title: Blind Two-Arm Ideation Study (Round 1 vs. Round 2)
question: Given only the raw exported data schema (175,187 files, 1.47M decls, 114M typed edges, ASTs, dominators, structural hashes), without mentioning specific tools or dimensionality-reduction techniques, which analysis ideas emerge independently across isolated personas versus live arguing panels — and when do ideas saturate?

arms.label: Round 1 — Isolated Personas (8)
arms.finding: Highest breadth (~34 distinct mechanisms). Independently rediscovered UMAP scatter, Hi-C contact maps, cross-library synteny dot-plots, harmonic potentials, and Galois lattices.

arms.label: Round 1 — Live Debate Panel A (5)
arms.finding: Caught real mathematical flaws (a DAG adjacency matrix is strictly triangular so all eigenvalues are 0; Euler's V-E+F has no canonical faces; random DAG rewiring breaks dependent types). Suffered classic groupthink: all 5 panelists converged on 'Proof Jenga' hybrids in Round 2.

arms.label: Round 2 — Isolated Specialist Personas (8)
arms.finding: 73% renamed duplicates of Round 1. All 15 genuinely new concepts came from deep specialists: von Neumann [T, P] commutator & register pressure, Compiler isDefEq profiler & Prop-erasure slicing, Genomicist dual-triangle Hi-C & paralog trees, Grothendieck Yoneda/Čech/Fibration slider, and Epigrapher UMAP rediscovery.

arms.label: Round 2 — Live Debate Panel B (5)
arms.finding: Avoided lexical groupthink by pitting incompatible constraints against each other (Compiler caught that dependent types compute on terms via delta/iota unfolding). Contamination note: the Genomics seat read a previous log note on the shared board and invented a nonexistent metric ('type-checking failure rate' on compiled proofs); both RevEng and Grothendieck caught and rejected it live.

top_unbuilt_candidates.summary: Put type-level edges in the upper triangle and proof-value edges in the lower triangle instead of blending both inside one upper triangle.

top_unbuilt_candidates.summary: Detect leaky abstractions where 'specify then prove' fails to commute with 'prove then lift', avoiding DAG nilpotency (λ = 0).

top_unbuilt_candidates.summary: Measure peak live free-variable width and fold Eq.mp/congrArg simp spines to separate verbose tactic output from genuinely dense reasoning.

top_unbuilt_candidates.title: Wrapper-Normalized (δ) Synteny + Kan Residual
top_unbuilt_candidates.summary: Unfold non-recursive wrapper definitions before structural hashing so renamed copies match Mathlib even across extra wrappers.

top_unbuilt_candidates.title: Dead-End & Foreign-Idiom Barcode Scanner
top_unbuilt_candidates.summary: Combine out-degree-0 orphaned lemma density with AST n-gram divergence to flag hand-patched files and stalled automated proofs.

key_mistakes_caught_in_debate: DAG adjacency eigenvalues are identically zero (all DAGs are strictly triangular)
Euler characteristic V - E + F lacks canonical 2-cell faces on a non-planar 114M-edge DAG
Typeless random-DAG rewiring breaks dependent type-checking and universe stratification
In dependent type theory, types compute on terms (delta/iota unfolding prevents naive type-only API cuts)
Live exported proofs are already compiled (no 'type-checking failure rate' exists inside the export)
